member.summary: Search USM official regulations and documents by semantic meaning. Use this tool for any question about regulations, official documents, articles, student rights, student obligations, duties, requirements, procedures, normative acts, legal basis, document approval, schedules rules, exams, credits, study contracts, or university rules.
